title: New age restrictions for ads on TikTok
content_data:
To help keep our community safe, including our younger users under the age of 18, the following new age restrictions are in place for any campaigns delivering to the United States, Latin America, the European Economic Area, the UK, Switzerland, or Canada: - Lead Generation objective campaigns can be used to target only ages 18 and older - Product Sales - Shop objective campaigns can be used to target only ages 18 and older New campaigns created using a placement that includes TikTok, Pangle, or Global App Bundle and targeting the United States, Latin America, the European Economic Area, the UK, Switzerland, or Canada will have the following updates: **Key changes** - Advertisers can still reach users from 13-17 but cannot combine this with personalized targeting tools. - Advertisers can continue to reach users aged 13-17 with location, device, or language targeting (For device targeting, device price is not allowed. For location targeting, restrict selections to country, DMA, city, or state — zip code targeting is not permitted.) - Advertisers will not be able to reach users aged 13-17 with gender, interest & behaviors, or any other personalization-based targeting. **Recommendations** If you are affected by the above changes, adjust your integration using one of the following methods: - Remove `AGE_13_17` from the `age_groups` field in the impacted endpoints. > **Note**
> If you typically leave the `age_groups` field unspecified or set it as `[]`, explicitly specify the exact age groups you need, such as `AGE_18_24`, `AGE_25_34`, `AGE_35_44`, `AGE_45_54`, and `AGE_55_100`, directly in the field. - Continue reaching users aged 13-17 using the targeting options for the device (excluding device price), language, or location (excluding zip code). If you are unable to adjust your integration to accommodate the above changes, the system will provide the following compatibility measures: - For certain ad group creation scenarios, if you trigger the new validation rules without manually specifying target age groups, the system will automatically set the age targeting to 18+ to pass validation. - For ad group update scenarios, we have introduced a new field, `exclude_age_under_eighteen`, in [/adgroup/update/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1739586761631745). If you trigger the validation rules, you can set `exclude_age_under_eighteen` to `true`, and the system will set the age targeting to 18+ to pass validation. To learn about the product change details, see [About advertising to people under the age of 18](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/about-advertising-to-people-under-the-age-of-18?lang=en).
